note: The normative JSON Schemas live in the spec repository. This pin records the exact tree they were vendored from. Run `pnpm schemas:sync` to re-copy after bumping `ref`. The sync script copies all 10 normative schemas (including common.schema.json). This repo additionally holds product-change.schema.json, a non-normative working-document schema pending spec RFC #5; it is not overwritten by the sync script.
